meaning.zh:
“打开一瓶冰镇的啤酒”。

这个短语来源于当你打开一瓶冰镇啤酒时产生的 “嘶” 声。在现代社会中，这个短语通常用来描述人们在工作或活动后放松时，打开一瓶冰镇饮料，通常是啤酒的场景。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the hissing sound made when you open a cold bottle of beer. In modern usage, it typically describes a relaxed atmosphere where people are opening a cold beverage, usually beer, after work or an activity.

lines.en: After a long day at work, he likes to *crack open a cold one* and unwind.
lines.zh: 工作了一整天之后，他喜欢打开一瓶冰镇啤酒放松一下。

lines.en: During the barbecue, everyone was *cracking open a cold one* and having a great time.
lines.zh: 在烧烤时，每个人都在打开冰镇啤酒，玩得非常开心。

lines.en: He invited his friends over to *crack open a cold one* and watch the game.
lines.zh: 他邀请朋友们过来一起打开冰镇啤酒看比赛。
